description: GTFS Lignes Piétonnes Montivilliers is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lignes Piétonnes. Le GTFS des lignes piétonnes mis à jour 3 fois par mois: Edition du 02/03/2026. Comporte les fichiers:. agency.txt. calendar.txt. calendar\dates.txt. shapes.txt. stops.txt. stop\times.txt. trips.txt Ce jeu de fichiers est libre de droit et open source. Ne nécessite aucune autorisation afin de le faire apparaître sur des sites, dans des applications etc... Coverage: Lignes Piétonnes. The publisher named on the listing is Lignes Piétonnes. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-03-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
